This blog is an outlet for ideas which naturally interest me. The research aims to be rigorous; shorter notes stay closer to the back-of-the-napkin spirit of [Tom Tango](http://www.tangotiger.com/index.php). Research and projects are collected below, with smaller notes appearing chronologically at the bottom.

[GitHub](https://github.com/spazznolo)
:::
